name: Librizzi (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Librizzi (a black eagle on red) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI LIBRIZZI in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Librizzi, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 25 March 1993.

features.role: Librizzi arms — black eagle on red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI LIBRIZZI arched above the arms
